payload.unit_title: R21 Seminar Workspace View and Print Summary (M2.5)
payload.objective: Evaluate next unit in dependency graph (M2.5) following M2.4 completion and issue initial read-only analysis TASK_DISPATCH (M2.5-ANALYZE-001) with strict global shell (<x-layouts.workspace-layout>, <x-layouts.report-layout>), global component (<x-ui.*>), and sub-500-line decomposition constraints.
payload.explicit_request: Unit M2.4 is COMPLETED and checkpointed (commit d239427bc9b92391f20208fe23655b043c296d2d). All dependencies for M2.5 are satisfied. Please issue the initial analysis TASK_DISPATCH for M2.5 (M2.5-ANALYZE-001). Every task must consider existing CampusLynk global shells and components to avoid duplication. Return decision: 'TASK_DISPATCH' with payload.task_dispatch.

payload.reason: M2.4 is checkpointed and satisfies the sole dependency for M2.5. The next step is a strictly read-only architectural analysis of the legacy R21 Seminar workspace and print views against the existing CampusLynk presentation architecture. The analysis must establish the complete functional inventory, map legacy UI structures to existing workspace-layout/report-layout and x-ui.* components, identify reusable partial opportunities, and produce a bounded implementation plan without modifying the repository. The mandatory sub-500-line decomposition constraint applies to both monolithic legacy views, and no new UI infrastructure may be proposed where an existing global component already provides the required behavior.

task_dispatch.objective: Perform a read-only forensic analysis of the legacy R21 Seminar Virtual Classroom and Seminar Print Summary, compare them with the existing CampusLynk M2.4 backend contract and global UI architecture, and determine the exact first implementation slice and decomposition plan for M2.5.
instructions: Inspect the migration control-plane state and feature matrix for M2.5 context.

Inspect the legacy virtual_classroom_seminar.blade.php (2,171 lines) and seminar_report_print.blade.php (680 lines) and inventory all functional UI regions, tabs, forms, tables, modals, scripts, report modes, data dependencies, routes, and backend interactions.
Inspect the existing CampusLynk workspace-layout and report-layout implementations and relevant x-ui.* components before proposing any UI structure.
Inspect the completed M2.4 R21VirtualClassroomSeminarController and its six routes to reconcile the legacy frontend requirements with the migrated backend contract.
Map every reusable legacy UI element to an existing CampusLynk global component where one exists; explicitly identify any apparent gaps rather than creating duplicate infrastructure.
Define a modular decomposition for both legacy views under resources/views/r21_seminar/partials/, ensuring every resulting Blade file remains below 500 lines.
Identify shared partials that can safely serve both workspace and print contexts without coupling the two master shells.
Determine the exact implementation slices for M2.5, including a recommended first implementation slice and its strict file whitelist.
Assess risks, parity gaps, route/controller assumptions, JavaScript dependencies, print/report requirements, and any ambiguities that must be resolved before implementation.
Do NOT modify any application files, Blade views, routes, controllers, models, migrations, tests, database state, or control-plane state.
Do NOT implement the proposed slices, create partials, or alter the design system.
constraints: DO NOT modify Blade views or create partials.
DO NOT modify routes or controllers.
DO NOT modify models, migrations, or database schema.
DO NOT execute migrations or destructive database commands.
DO NOT modify docs/migration/STATE.json or FEATURE_MATRIX.md.
All applicable UI controls MUST reuse existing <x-ui.*> components.
DO NOT propose ad-hoc buttons, custom modal infrastructure, or raw table markup where equivalent global components exist.
Every migrated Blade view/partial MUST remain below 500 lines.
Do not expand scope into unrelated R21 features or M2.6+ units.
task_dispatch.expected_report: Complete legacy functional inventory for both R21 Seminar views; backend/frontend route and data dependency reconciliation against M2.4; existing global shell/component mapping; proposed sub-500-line partial decomposition; shared-partial opportunities; implementation slice plan with the recommended first slice and exact file whitelist; parity gaps, risks, ambiguities, and verification requirements; confirmation that no repository modifications were made.
stop_conditions: Stop immediately if implementation changes would be required to perform the analysis.
Do not modify any repository file.
Do not execute database migrations or alter database state.
Stop after producing the read-only TASK_REPORT.
